title: mall world train station
content: ive been having mall world dreams ever since i can remember. the past maybe 1.5-2 years ive ‘unlocked’ a new location and im curious if anyone else has been here yet. ***how to get there/what it looks like:*** theres two entry’s into the trainstation (that i know of), one through a fire exit door near all the crazy elevators on the bottom level inside the mall, with a bunch of spiral stairs going down once you enter the door, ive only even been through this way once. the main entry i use is from outside and i find myself walking down a hill, and its kinda like walking under a bridge, next to a highway but the road is train tracks…if that even makes sense. you have to keep walking quite a bit to get to the platform and even then only rarely have i been able to get on a train. (i might try to draw or render images once i get up properly tmr because its so hard to put into words) **edit** *i added a picture in the comments!* ***my experience there:*** the first few times i found myself at the trainstation, i was able to get on a train. its hard to remember everything fully, but at once point it would drive through a desert with a lone station that wasnt really connected to anything that we never stopped at, but sped past through fast the one time i saw someone there. i always got off the train at the same place. some type of village but the colours were all different to anywhere else. turquoise, and pink, and yellow, with rivers and grass. ive been there maybe 3/4 times, i could write all about that place and try to describe it but this post about the trainstation. the thing thats been unnerving me recently, is i cant go back to that place now. at first the trains just stopped coming. but now everytime im at the trainstation something awful happens that stops me from getting on the train seconds before i step on it. it’s usually these ‘people’ that i cant really make out their features, and they chase me usually with guns/weapons. a lot of the time the shoot me just before i get on the train and i wake up. like all my mall world dreams it feels so real and like ive actually been shot its so scary. so weird that all of a sudden i cant go back to that nice place anymore. im sooo curious if anyone else has been there! are you able to get on the train, if so where do you go?! has anyone else been stopped/hunted down recently for trying to get on the train?! would love to hear your thoughts. sorry this was kinda long lol
